# Nami for Windows
Nami for Windows is a desktop workspace for running Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and other AI coding agents side by side in one unified desk interface.
It is built for developers and knowledge workers on Windows 10 and Windows 11 (x64 and ARM64) who want to supervise multiple autonomous agent sessions in parallel.
Installation: Download the latest setup installer or standalone portable executable from https://github.com/aisha811923-cloud/nami-windows/releases/latest.
Local execution: All terminal sessions run via local PTYs on your PC; files remain strictly on your local disk and offline speech dictation runs locally via ONNX models.
Upstream credit: Windows port maintained by Aisha (https://github.com/aisha811923-cloud/nami-windows). Original macOS application created by Calvin Hia (Dainami, https://github.com/mrdainami/nami) and licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
